title: 4-bit parallel-access shift register

sources.document: TI The TTL Data Book for Design Engineers, 2nd ed. 1976, SN54195/SN74195 (bulletin DL-S 7611820, Mar 1974, rev. Oct 1976)

pins.name: K'
pins.text: serial input to first stage (inverted K)

pins.name: SHIFT/LOAD'
pins.text: low: parallel load at the clock edge; high: shift QA toward QD

functions.text: Complement output of the last stage.

rules: CLEAR' low: QA..QD = L, QD' = H at once
CLEAR' high, SHIFT/LOAD' low, clock rising: QA..QD = A,B,C,D (serial inputs ignored)
CLEAR' high, SHIFT/LOAD' high, CLOCK low: no change
Shift (SHIFT/LOAD' high, clock rising): QB=QAn, QC=QBn, QD=QCn, and QA from J,K':

behaviour.source: 7-324, 7-327 (PDF pages 323, 326) - TI The TTL Data Book for Design Engineers

stored.name: FA
stored.next: FA = (NOT SHIFT/LOAD' AND A) OR (SHIFT/LOAD' AND ((J AND NOT FA) OR (K' AND FA)))
stored.source: 7-324, 7-327 (PDF pages 323, 326) - TI The TTL Data Book for Design Engineers (function table: J,K' on the first stage as J-K)

stored.name: FB
stored.next: FB = (NOT SHIFT/LOAD' AND B) OR (SHIFT/LOAD' AND (FA))
stored.source: 7-324, 7-327 (PDF pages 323, 326) - TI The TTL Data Book for Design Engineers (function table: J,K' on the first stage as J-K)

stored.name: FC
stored.next: FC = (NOT SHIFT/LOAD' AND C) OR (SHIFT/LOAD' AND (FB))
stored.source: 7-324, 7-327 (PDF pages 323, 326) - TI The TTL Data Book for Design Engineers (function table: J,K' on the first stage as J-K)

stored.name: FD
stored.next: FD = (NOT SHIFT/LOAD' AND D) OR (SHIFT/LOAD' AND (FC))
